test_title: PYST 06: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between D and A when counted from the left of A. H sits third to the left of G. I sits to the immediate right of G. I sits second to the left of D. B is not an immediate neighbor of H. Who sits third to the right of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) H sits third to the left of G.

2) I sits to the immediate right of G

3) I sits second to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/862ba71f7d82484f106bb92ae1569e456663a0ce6ae0aa44c2f3b025e25eae09.png] 

4) Only two people sit between D and A when counted from the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaeabd236ba8951ab5817251b69c3e0b74f6704ba31758cc935ce498d425b791.png] 

5) B is not an immediate neighbor of H.

After positioning B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afff864fdb6639b41824ee10906e82fafa1c9853c268113e871c8a245ba647de.png] 

Thus, I sits third to the right of C.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
